facts.text: Roger, the kids are fed. The clocks stop at 3:07, so we wait up with tea tonight.
facts.why: The quote page is thin and has no line like this for Carolyn. Her one listed line is 'I don't hear anything.' April's real music box line is on the page.
facts.fix: When the music stops, you see him in the mirror, standing behind you.
